newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh central bank moves taka lower vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh central bank moves taka lower vs dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh central bank shifted the value of the taka lower against U.S. dollar to 44.00/20 from 43.55/75, effective Monday, a bank circular said on Sunday.
The central bank gave no explanation for the depreciation of more than one percent, the first such move in fiscal 1997/98, which began July 1.
The last time the taka was adjusted was on April 7.

Officials at commercial banks said the central bank's move was aimed at boosting the country's exports and keeping pace with the movements of other major currencies. The country's exporters of garments, which fetch about $2.0 billion annually, have been demanding a devaluation of the currency to stay competitive in the international market.
